parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Odufor (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 20.32 | 0.13606 | 0.13606
2 | 851.16 | 1.1039 | 1.2399
3 | 2511.9 | 15.803 | 17.043
4 | 1345 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as AK-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Odufor
Curve type: AK-type
Aquifer depth: ≥ 17.04 m (aquiferous zone begins at the base of the 2511.9 Ω·m layer, within the underlying 1345 Ω·m layer, which is open-ended at depth)
Recommendation: Plan the borehole to penetrate past 17 m into the lower-resistivity 1345 Ω·m layer, which likely represents the saturated, water-bearing horizon; case off the upper high-resistivity layers to prevent borehole collapse and ensure proper well development once the aquifer is reached.
